title: ESM3 and esmGFP: a fluorescent protein designed by a language model
summary: ESM3 designed esmGFP, a fluorescent protein of 229 amino acids with 96 mutations relative to the closest known protein (about 58% similarity). In a second round of 96 designs, some proteins glowed as brightly as natural GFPs. The comparison with ‘more than 500 million years of evolution’ is an analogy-based estimate.

evidence.tested: In two rounds of 96 designs, lab measurements of fluorescence found some proteins as bright as natural GFPs; esmGFP differs by 96 mutations and is about 58% similar to the closest natural protein.
evidence.unknown: The page lists no formal limitations; the designed B8 was about 50 times dimmer and slower to mature than natural GFPs.
evidence.ai_role: ESM3 generated new GFP candidates prompted with structural residues from natural GFP.
